findings.fix: Remove @[simp]; keep it as a plain rw/computation lemma (the file's own example uses rw).
findings.issue: characteristicWeight_cubeVertex is @[simp] but expands χ_k(cubeVertex x S) into a strictly larger term whose middle summand χ_k(∑ v∈S, E_v) is itself irreducible by simp for symbolic S — no normal form is reached. Its LHS head characteristicWeight k (cubeVertex x _) appears abstractly in CubeWeight.lean (e.g. characteristicWeight_cubeVertex_le_characteristicCubeWeight, line 233), so simp will detonate those clean terms into coordinate expansions. The whole-set polarization analogue characteristicWeight_add (WeightPolarization.lean:67) is deliberately not @[simp].

findings.issue: characteristicWeightNumerator_cubeVertex is @[simp] but rewrites a compact vertex numerator into a base numerator plus three sums — a computation/evaluation lemma, not a simp normal form. Its head characteristicWeightNumerator k (cubeVertex x _) will fire and blow up any abstract goal mentioning it.

summary: The API surface is otherwise minimal and well-formed, but the two cube-vertex weight expansion lemmas are wrongly annotated @[simp]: they are rw-style computation lemmas whose RHS is a larger, non-normal form, and they fire on the abstract cube-vertex weight terms used throughout CubeWeight.lean.
